defects.title: A structure without a rxns field is silently not saved
defects.observed: no file written, no warning or error (isfield test on line 15 has no else branch)
defects.expected: the structure is saved, per the header 'Saves a data variable (e.g., model)'

notes: Covers small model (v7 file, header MATLAB 5.0), >= 300000 reactions (v7.3, header MATLAB 7.3; a sparse rxns column of length 300000 keeps the file tiny), cell and numeric data saved as data. The limitation input (struct without rxns) is skipped; no toolbox caller passes one (analyseObjectiveShadowPrices passes a cell; analyseWBMs has its own local parsave).

Pins the undocumented side effect: detectOutput leaves the current folder at resPath (cd without restore); createPersonalizedModel relies on it for relative parsave file names. Returns the index in the dir list of .mat files (exact match via strmatch), empty otherwise.

No callers in the ledger.

notes: Exempt: 25-62 pre-R2020a branch (version contains '(R202' on R2025a); 68-69 only reachable from that branch (readtable with VariableNamingRule 'modify' returns valid names); 75 dead (makeValidName always yields a valid name). defects.title: Errors when the taxon table has fewer rows than columns
defects.observed: MATLAB:badsubscript, Index in position 1 exceeds array bounds. Index must not exceed 3. (line 42 loops over length(taxonInformation) = 6 columns, line 43 reads row 4)
defects.expected: one Competition for each of g1 and g2, two for family f1 and every higher level

notes: Repro (MATLAB): pw = {'Pair','M1','M2','a','b','c','d','Outcome1','Outcome2'; 'A_B','A','B',0,0,0,0,'Competition','Competition'}; tx = {'ModelID','Genus','Family','Order','Class','Phylum'; 'A','g1','f1','o1','c1','p1'; 'B','g2','f1','o1','c1','p1'}; calculateInteractionsByTaxon(pw, tx)  -> MATLAB:badsubscript. Only taxon tables with fewer rows than columns trigger it (in practice the full AGORA taxon table is usually long), so the lead may judge the severity. Also noted, not recorded: line 60 uses strncmp('unclassified', taxa, 1), i.e. it drops every taxon starting with a lower-case 'u', not only 'unclassified'; the header says 'table' but the code needs cell arrays. No callers in the ledger.
confirmed_by: lead (source read: for i = 1:length(taxonInformation) takes the larger dimension of the cell array, line 42)
